senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; טָבַע II)round band, ring.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 1</cite> <he>ט׳ שהוא חוגר וכ׳</he> a ring which one puts around his loins; <he>ט׳ של אצבע</he> finger ring; <cite ref="Shabbat 52b:13">Sabb. 52ᵇ</cite>.
Ib.; Kel. XII, 1 ט׳ אדם ornamental ring; ט׳ בהמה והכלים a ring used for beasts or for garments (for fastening); a. fr.—Esp. seal-ring.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:24">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>; a. fr.—<he>הֲסָרַת ט׳</he> the authority given by transfer of the ring.
<cite ref="Megillah 14a:3">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4">Lam. R. to IV, 22</cite>.—Pl. <he>טַבָּעוֹת</he>. Sabb. l. c.; a. fr.—
Ab. d’R. N. ch. XVIII ט׳ ט׳, v. מַטְבֵּעַ.—Trnsf. (פי הט׳) anus, end of the rectum.
<cite ref="Shabbat 108b:13">Sabb. 108ᵇ</cite> bot.; a. fr.—Y. ib. VIII, end, 11ᶜ <he>לטבעות</he>, read <he>לטבעת</he>, v. <cite ref="A01976"><he>אַמְבְּטִיתָא</he></cite>.
